verdict.rationale: Brex markets AI assistants that fetch receipts and offer policy help (brex-docs-23). It also describes a review agent that follows up with anyone out of compliance (brex-docs-16), and says Brex AI applies spend rules to every transaction (brex-docs-8, brex-docs-41). These cover receipt-chasing and general policy guidance, but only as one-line marketing claims, with no detail on the conversational experience. Missing for 10: any evidence that the assistant explains card declines, documented pre-spend "can I expense this?" Q&A, product docs or hands-on corroboration of the conversational interaction.
